'''Johannes Frederik Gerardus (Hans) Vliegenthart''' (April 7, 1936 – February 12, 2026) was a Dutch [[emeritus]] professor in [[bioorganic chemistry]] of [[Utrecht University]], well known for his research on the synthesis and characterisation of [[carbohydrates]], and [[biomolecule]]s containing sugar moieties such as [[glycoproteins]] and their role in living [[cell (biology)|cells]].

==Biography==
Hans Vliegenthart was born in [[Zuilen]], the Netherlands in 1936. He studied chemistry at [[Utrecht University]] from 1953 to 1960,<ref name="profilepageUU">{{cite web|url=https://www.uu.nl/medewerkers/JFGVliegenthart/CV|title=Profile of Prof. dr. J.F.G. (Hans) Vliegenthart|publisher=Utrecht University|accessdate=2019-04-17}}</ref> where he also received his PhD degree in 1967, under supervision of prof. Arens.<ref name="catalogusprofessorum">{{cite web|url=https://profs.library.uu.nl/index.php/profrec/getprofdata/2216/2/4/0|title=Prof.dr. J.F.G. Vliegenthart|publisher=Catologus Professorum, Utrecht University|accessdate=2019-04-17}}</ref> In 1975, he was appointed [[Lecturer|lector]] (a defunct Dutch academic role that changed to professor in 1980) bio-organic chemistry at Utrecht University<ref name="NRC1975">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=KBNRC01:000032703:mpeg21:p003|title=Dr. J.F.G. Vliegenthart|date=1975-04-04|work=[[NRC Handelsblad]]|page=3|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref> and was full professor at Utrecht University from 1984 until 2003.<ref name="catalogusprofessorum"/> From 1999 until 2004, he was also the chairman of the Utrecht University Fund and he still awarded every year the Vliegenthart Thesis Award.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uu.nl/en/organisation/alumni/money-well-spent/vliegenthart-thesis-prize|title=Vliegenthart Thesis Award|publisher=Utrecht University|accessdate=2019-04-17|date=2015-07-03}}</ref> In 1988, the founded the [[Bijvoet Centre for Biomolecular Research]] at Utrecht University,<ref name="CC_Apr_1988">{{Cite news
|title=SON en RUU in Bijvoet Centrum|author=Joop Kessels|newspaper=Chemische Courant|date=April 7, 1988|language=Dutch}}</ref><ref name="NRC_Apr_1988">{{Cite news|title='Bijvoet-centrum voor moleculair Onderzoek' geopend|author=b.k.|newspaper=[[NRC Handelsblad]]|date=April 1988|language=Dutch}}</ref> and he served as the scientific director of the institute until 2000. He served as Dean of the Faculty of Chemistry from 1985 to 1989 and from 2000 to 2003 and in 2003 he became Honorary Professor at Utrecht University.<ref name="CVUU">{{cite web|url=https://www.uu.nl/medewerkers/JFGVliegenthart/CV|title=Curriculum Vitae Hans Vliegenthart|publisher=[[Utrecht University]]|accessdate=2019-04-30}}</ref> Hans Vliegenthart died on February 12th, 2026.<ref name=DEATHUU>{{cite web|url=https://www.uu.nl/en/news/in-memoriam-hans-vliegenthart|title=In memoriam: Hans Vliegenthart|publisher=[[Utrecht University]]|accessdate=2026-02-16}}</ref>

==Research==
The research of Vliegenthart focused on the synthesis and characterisation of [[carbohydrates]], [[glycoproteins]], [[glycolipids]] and [[proteoglycan]]s and their role in living [[Cell (biology)|cells]].<ref name="NARCIS">{{cite web|url=https://www.narcis.nl/person/RecordID/PRS1234630/Language/en|title=Person: Prof. dr. J.F.G. (Hans) Vliegenthart|publisher=[[NARCIS]]|accessdate=2019-04-30}}</ref><ref name="Volkskrant1984a">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ABCDDD:010879481:mpeg21:p031|author=Jan Blom|title=Koolhydraten: toekomstige grondstof voor de industrie|date=1984-06-30|work=[[De Volkskrant]]|page=31|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref> He was most famous for his work on the analysis of the primary and three-dimensional structures of carbohydrates and glycoproteins using technologies such as [[NMR spectroscopy]],<ref>{{cite book|doi=10.1016/S0065-2318(08)60059-1|chapter=High-Resolution, 1H-Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy as a Tool in the Structural Analysis of Carbohydrates Related to Glycoproteins|title=Advances in Carbohydrate Chemistry and Biochemistry Volume 41|volume=41|pages=209–374|year=1983|last1=Vliegenthart|first1=Johannes F.G.|last2=Dorland|first2=Lambertus|last3=Halbeek|first3=Herman van|isbn=9780120072415|hdl=1874/5376}}</ref> [[chromatography]]<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1016/S0008-6215(00)80881-2|title=Determination of the d and l configuration of neutral monosaccharides by high-resolution capillary g.l.c|journal=Carbohydrate Research|volume=62|issue=2|pages=349–357|year=1978|last1=Gerwig|first1=Gerrit J.|last2=Kamerling|first2=Johannis P.|last3=Vliegenthart|first3=Johannes F.G.|hdl=1874/5304|hdl-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1016/S0008-6215(00)83788-X|pmid=519653|title=Determination of the absolute configuration of monosaccharides in complex carbohydrates by capillary g.l.c|journal=Carbohydrate Research|volume=77|pages=1–7|year=1979|last1=Gerwig|first1=Gerit J.|last2=Kamerling|first2=Johannis P.|last3=Vliegenthart|first3=Johannes F.G.|hdl=1874/5300|hdl-access=free}}</ref> and other analytical methods.<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1016/0008-6215(95)00270-7|title=Short-range structure in (partially) crystalline potato starch determined with attenuated total reflectance Fourier-transform IR spectroscopy|journal=Carbohydrate Research|volume=279|pages=201–214|year=1995|last1=Van Soest|first1=Jeroen J.G.|last2=Tournois|first2=Hubertus|last3=De Wit|first3=Dick|last4=Vliegenthart|first4=Johannes F.G.|hdl=1874/5571|hdl-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1021/bi00617a021|pmid=728395|title=Determination of the primary structures of 16 asialo-carbohydrate units derived from human plasma α1-acid glycoprotein by 360-MHZ proton NMR spectroscopy and permethylation analysis|journal=Biochemistry|volume=17|issue=24|pages=5206–5214|year=1978|last1=Fournet|first1=Bernard|last2=Montreuil|first2=Jean|last3=Strecker|first3=Gerard|last4=Dorland|first4=Lambertus|last5=Haverkamp|first5=Johan|last6=Vliegenthart|first6=Johannes F. G.|last7=Binette|first7=J. Paul|last8=Schmid|first8=Karl}}</ref> Vliegenthart applied his knowledge on carbohydrates to various fields of biology and medicine, such as research into [[blood types]], which are largely determined by carbohydrates on [[red blood cells]],<ref name="Trouw1984">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ABCDDD:010820912:mpeg21:p015|title=De informatie zit in de staart|date=1984-09-05|work=[[Trouw]]|page=15|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref> synthetic [[vaccine]]s to protect against [[Streptococcus pneumoniae]]<ref name="Volkskrant1987">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ABCDDD:010857008:mpeg21:p039|title=Synthetisch vaccin helpt afweersysteem|author=Maarten Evenblij|date=1987-11-14|work=[[De Volkskrant]]|page=39|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref> and the role of sugar molecules in [[tumor]] growth.<ref name="Volkskrant1984b">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ABCDDD:010879481:mpeg21:p031|author=Maarten Evenblij|title=Suikermoleculen spelen rol bij tumorgroei|date=1984-06-30|work=[[De Volkskrant]]|page=31|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
Throughout his career, Vliegenthart has received numerous honours and awards. He has been a member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]] since 1987, which allows him to nominate people for the [[Nobel Prize]] 
.<ref name="LeeuwarderCourant1989">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ddd:010566916:mpeg21:p048|title=Utrechtse hoogleraar onderscheiden|date=1989-03-25|work=[[Leeuwarder Courant]]|page=48|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref> In 1989, Vliegenthart became honorary member of the [[American Society for Biochemistry and Molecular Biology]], for his contributions to biochemistry and molecular biology, not only in the Netherlands, but at the highest international level.<ref name="Parool1989">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ABCDDD:010833022:mpeg21:p002|title=Onderscheiding prof. Vliegenthart|date=1989-03-21|work=[[Het Parool]]|page=2|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref><ref name="Trouw1989">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ABCDDD:010827965:mpeg21:p002|title=Personalia|date=1989-03-21|work=[[Trouw]]|page=2|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref><ref name="Volkskrant1989">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ABCDDD:010856371:mpeg21:p006|title=Persoonlijk|date=1989-03-21|work=[[De Volkskrant]]|page=6|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref><ref name="NederlandsDagblad1989">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ddd:010559008:mpeg21:p003|title=Personalia|date=1989-03-21|work=[[Nederlands Dagblad]]|page=3|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref><ref name="Trouw1992a">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=KBNRC01:000031277:mpeg21:p007|title=Personalia|date=1989-04-11|work=[[NRC Handelsblad]]|page=7|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref> Vliegenthart has been a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] of the Netherlands since 1990.<ref name="KNAW">{{cite web|url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4940?set_language=en|title=Hans Vliegenthart|publisher=[[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]]|accessdate=2019-04-30|archive-date=11 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200811155543/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4940?set_language=en|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 1992, he received an [[honorary doctorate]] from the Lajos Kossuth University in Debrecen, Hungary, nowadays known as the [[University of Debrecen]].<ref name="Trouw1992b">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ABCDDD:010822163:mpeg21:p002|title=Personalia|date=1992-12-08|work=[[Trouw]]|page=2|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref> In 1993 [[Lille University of Science and Technology]] in France bestowed him with an honorary doctorate for his contribution to the structural analysis of carbohydrate chains.<ref name="Trouw1993">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ABCDDD:010821727:mpeg21:p002|title=Personalia|date=1993-04-01|work=[[Trouw]]|page=2|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref> Vliegenthart was awarded the [[Claude Hudson#Claude S. Hudson Award|Claude S. Hudson Award]] in Carbohydrate Chemistry of the [[American Chemical Society]] in 1994.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.acs.org/content/acs/en/funding-and-awards/awards/national/bytopic/claude-s-hudson-award-in-carbohydrate-chemistry.html|title=Claude S. Hudson Award in Carbohydrate Chemistry|publisher=[[American Chemical Society]]|accessdate=2019-04-30}}</ref><ref name="Volkskrant1994">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ABCDDD:010866498:mpeg21:p009|title=Persoonlijk|date=1993-09-18|work=[[Volkskrant]]|page=9|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref><ref name="NRC1994">{{cite news|url=https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=KBNRC01:000030972:mpeg21:p002|title=Personalia|date=1992-09-23|work=[[NRC Handelsblad]]|page=2|accessdate=2019-04-30|language=Dutch}}</ref> In 1997, the [[Stockholm University]] in Sweden awarded him an honorary doctorate.<ref name="CVUU"/> He became Knight of the [[Order of the Netherlands Lion]] in 1998.<ref name="CVUU"/> In 2000, he received the Bijvoet Medal of the [[Bijvoet Centre for Biomolecular Research]] of [[Utrecht University]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uu.nl/en/research/bijvoet-centre-for-biomolecular-research/about-us/bijvoet-medal|title=Bijvoet Medal|publisher=Bijvoet Centre for Biomolecular Research|accessdate=2019-04-30}}</ref> The [[University of Rome Tor Vergata]] in [[Italy]] awarded him their medal in 2001<ref name="CVUU"/> and his alma mater, Utrecht University, awarded him their silver medal in 2003.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uu.nl/organisatie/archief-zilveren-penning|title=Zilveren penning|publisher=Utrecht University|language=Dutch|accessdate=2019-05-02}}</ref> In October 2017, the Council of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]] (AAAS) elected Vliegenthart as a Fellow of AAAS for his contributions to science and technology in its Section on Biological Sciences.<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1126/science.358.6366.1011|title=2017 AAAS Fellows approved by the AAAS Council|journal=Science|volume=358|issue=6366|pages=1011–1014|year=2017|bibcode=2017Sci...358.1011.|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uu.nl/en/news/hans-vliegenthart-chosen-aaas-fellow|title=Hans Vliegenthart chosen AAAS Fellow|publisher=[[Utrecht University]]|date=2017-12-18|accessdate=2019-04-30}}</ref>
